universe_rules.derived_from: admitted lifecycle only, including blocked/never-issued units and steps
universe_rules.admittedTemplatesDigest: canonical admitted obligation universe before instantiation
universe_rules.expectedObligationsDigest: canonical instantiated expectations, excluding any candidate satisfaction decision
universe_rules.applicability: checked from the admitted state machine and retained intent/issuance/terminal evidence; missing/contradictory applicability evidence is unverifiable, never not-applicable
universe_rules.health_slots: slot boundaries derive from the admitted host cadence and the actual bounded active interval; a missing endpoint cannot shorten the universe and cannot be hidden by a paused tick

obligation_templates.satisfied_by: public intent event + durable M3 intent
public issued event + broker issuance record

obligation_templates.required_when: unit reached running and has a dependent
a normal M3 start outcome is expected
unit active across a cadence slot
obligation_templates.satisfied_by: health event for the exact slot
exactly one disposition event per step
indexed relative path + actual byte hash

branch_expectations.mutation: record intent, failed normal outcome, cancellation, blocked dependent disposition, exact teardown/collection and run-terminal failure
branch_expectations.note: a failed run can be factually complete

branch_expectations.mutation: omit the normal M3 outcome entirely; retain all other normal records
omit the normal M3 outcome but record an emergency unresolved intent/cleanup disposition
branch_expectations.note: the emergency unresolved disposition documents the failure but cannot satisfy the mandatory normal-record obligation

branch_expectations.mutation: issued workload; normal outcome lost; emergency cleanup fully observed through C1
branch_expectations.note: cleanup complete and evidence incomplete can coexist

branch_expectations.mutation: issuer registry replaced; retained capability cleans exact boundary
all sinks fail after issued workload; in-memory terminal result only
all lifecycle event obligations satisfied; report artifact missing
generic Argus assessment complete; source ready event removed

deletion_mutations_that_must_not_reduce_: delete a unit disposition for a blocked unit

aggregation_precedence.rule: missing/conflicting applicable rows dominate; a complete generic Argus assessment never promotes missing lifecycle coverage; a pre-closure assessment is never authoritative

independence_note: Rows and branch expectations are authored from the admitted design before any candidate routine exists and are not derived from any implementation.
limitations: No assessor or reader was executed; expected statuses are design-only.
Numeric health-slot counts depend on admitted cadence and actual bounded interval, both currently unmeasured.
